title: Ryland Expert Blinded Review Record
description: Schema for expert-labeled drug-disease predictions returned by Ryland Mortlock (Yale, dermatology). Each record is one predicted pair evaluated by the expert. Records are ingested by scripts/import_ryland_review.py and written to data/reference/expert_labels_ryland.json. Expert labels are tagged with provenance = 'expert_ryland' and are kept out of any data structure that feeds embedding/kNN training to avoid leakage.

prediction_id.description: Opaque identifier linking back to a row in drug_repurposing_predictions_with_confidence.xlsx. Preferred form: '<disease_id>||<drug_id>' (DRKG entity IDs). Must be unique within a review batch.

drug.description: Human-readable drug name exactly as shown to the reviewer.

drug_id.description: Optional DRKG compound entity (e.g., 'drkg:Compound::DB00945'). If absent, the importer will attempt to resolve from the drug name using production_predictor's alias map.

disease.description: Human-readable disease name exactly as shown to the reviewer.

disease_id.description: Optional DRKG disease entity (e.g., 'drkg:Disease::MESH:D003550'). If absent, the importer will attempt to resolve via disease_name_matcher.

verdict.description: Expert verdict. 'known' = already standard-of-care; 'plausible' = novel but biologically reasonable; 'implausible' = not supported by mechanism or evidence; 'adverse' = drug actively harms this disease (drug-induced or contraindicated); 'unsure' = reviewer could not decide (excluded from precision).

reasoning.description: Free-text rationale for the verdict. Required for 'implausible' and 'adverse' verdicts to aid GT-gap / inverse-indication rules; optional otherwise.

reviewer_confidence.description: 1 = low confidence, 5 = certain. Predictions with reviewer_confidence <= 2 should be excluded from tier precision unless explicitly opted in.

reviewer.description: Reviewer handle. For this batch, always 'ryland_mortlock'.

review_date.description: ISO 8601 date when the review was completed.

provenance.description: Fixed tag. Used downstream to keep expert labels out of kNN/embedding training. NEVER merge into predictor.ground_truth or expanded_ground_truth.json.

evidence_citations.description: Optional PMIDs / NCT IDs / DOIs supporting the verdict.
